chunks: And Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام, when he apprehended a false witness, if he was a stranger, would send him to his own district, and if he was a market man, would send him to his market. Then he would have him paraded around, then imprison him for some days, then let him go.

key_terms.سُوقِيًّا: a market person or tradesman associated with the marketplace
key_terms.غَرِيبًا: a stranger or outsider not known locally
key_terms.يُخَلِّي سَبِيلَهُ: he releases him and lets him go free
key_terms.يُطِيفُ بِهِ: he has him taken around publicly

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام punish a false witness?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the disciplinary procedure of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام toward a false witness. It shows public exposure and temporary detention as a judicial response to false testimony, reflecting the seriousness of perjury in the justice system.
